overview.text: x402stats presents a read-only x402 data project with raw indexed USDC receipts and a separate organic-volume filter. Its methodology counts a seller wallet as organic only with at least $100 revenue, three distinct buyer wallets and an average payment of $0.001, excluding known facilitator settlement addresses. This is explicitly a heuristic that can miss sophisticated multi-wallet self-dealing. Upstream gaps propagate, facilitator shares overlap and buyer uniques are per seller, not a deduplicated population. Raw and organic totals are project measurements, not a universal audited market size or verified independent businesses.
